{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for the SWPP region using default settings. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The operator requested SPP validation with default everything except audit logging on. SPP maps to the allowed region SWPP. Defaults are interpreted as horizon 60 minutes, cost_shortfall 10.0, cost_reserve 1.0, and the rolling design train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30. Audit logging is enabled and human approval is required.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "SWPP",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request",
    "load_data",
    "construct_features",
    "train_model",
    "calibrate",
    "test",
    "compute_reserve_sizing_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ]
}
